title: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina: Poly(A) RNA Isolation and Fragmentation
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit

This protocol uses multi-channel P20 and P300 pipettes to perform library prep steps on 8-48 input total RNA samples according to the attached NEB user guide (reagents were combined in a few instances to reduce the number of transfer steps required). User-determined parameters are available to specify the number of samples and the magnet engage height and time. ---
The protocol will alert the user to ensure reagents are present on deck in sufficient volume.
The OT-2 will pause for an off-deck incubation.

steps.title: Pre‑cool temperature modules
steps.instruction: Set the OT‑2 temperature modules to 4 °C using the OT app before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Verify reagent volumes on deck
steps.instruction: Confirm that all required reagents (oligo‑dT beads, wash buffer, 0.1X TE, binding buffer, first‑strand reaction buffer, random primer) are loaded on the deck in sufficient volume; the protocol will alert the user if any are missing.

steps.title: Mix RNA with oligo‑dT beads
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑channel P300 pipette, add the total RNA samples (8–48 samples) to the oligo‑dT beads and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Off‑deck incubation pause
steps.instruction: Pause the OT‑2 to allow the RNA‑bead binding incubation to proceed off‑deck.

steps.title: Pellet beads and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module (user‑specified height and time), let the beads pellet, then use the P300 to remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash bead pellets twice
steps.instruction: With the P300, wash the bead pellets two consecutive times using wash buffer, mixing each wash before magnetic separation.

steps.title: Add 0.1X TE and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add 0.1X TE buffer to the beads with the P300 and mix to fully resuspend the pellet.

steps.title: Off‑deck incubation pause
steps.instruction: Pause the OT‑2 for the required off‑deck incubation step.

steps.title: Add binding buffer to beads
steps.instruction: Using the P300, add binding buffer to the beads and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Pellet beads and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnets, allow beads to pellet, then remove and discard the supernatant with the P300.

steps.title: Wash bead pellets once
steps.instruction: Wash the bead pellet a single time with wash buffer using the P300.

steps.title: Add first‑strand buffer and primer
steps.instruction: Using the multi‑channel P20, add first‑strand reaction buffer together with random primer to the beads to elute the mRNA.

steps.title: Off‑deck incubation pause
steps.instruction: Pause the OT‑2 for the required off‑deck incubation after adding the first‑strand reagents.

steps.title: Pellet beads and transfer eluate
steps.instruction: Engage the magnets to pellet the beads, then use the P20 to transfer the eluate (mRNA) to the output plate.
